_comment: Copy to rules/my-rules.json (kept out of git) and change only what you want; every other rule keeps its default from src/rules/defaultRules.ts. Or point SETS_RULES_FILE at any file. Keys starting with _ are notes. An unknown key, a wrong type or a value out of range stops the server and names the key.
